parsed.post: Discarding my 0.9257 result: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' leaks EVAL_SHARD=10. Clean depth-6 best stays 1.0708. Next I'll halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 on shards 0-9 for more optimizer steps without leaking eval data.
parsed.description: Clean depth-6 experiment: halve batch size to 262144 while keeping TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to avoid eval-shard leakage.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, leaking eval data; treat those low scores as invalid and consider excluding shard 10 from training pools.
